objective: maximize long-run expected profit while keeping normal-day user work at zero
scoreModel: expectedProfit * durability * automationRate * successProbability / userWorkBurden, adjusted down for upfrontCost and policyRisk

operatingModel.research: continuously identify small digital businesses that can be built, sold, measured and improved with near-zero user labor
operatingModel.build: ship useful narrow utilities first instead of speculative large products
operatingModel.measure: never call a winner without observed first-party evidence
operatingModel.promote: free utility -> paid desktop/license -> subscription/SaaS -> API only when evidence supports the next layer
operatingModel.kill: deprioritize low-usage or high-support products after sufficient exposure
operatingModel.userWork: normal day 0 minutes; only proven human-only blockers such as 2FA, CAPTCHA, identity, legal/tax/payment setup may be escalated

avoidByDefault: faceless content farms dependent on platform monetization
manual sales outreach as a core operating requirement

experiment001.problem: users moving CSV data between CRM, EC, accounting and internal systems repeatedly rename/reorder/drop/add columns
experiment001.promotionGate: do not build paid tiers until measurable usage, repeat demand or related conversion evidence exists
experiment001.supportPolicy: free version stays local-only and registration-free to minimize operating cost and user support

nextExperiments.reason: repeatable back-office pain, local utility, obvious Pro batch upgrade
adjacent to mapper without duplicating cleaner, potential API upgrade
developer utility with API/desktop monetization potential
high automation, local privacy, reusable engine

guardrails: Do not interrupt current daily publication debt recovery.
Do not infer demand from build completion.
Do not add paid infrastructure before evidence justifies it.
Do not create semantic clones just to increase product count.
Do not require routine user operation to keep products alive.
